description: In order to have a vigorous police force for a city our size, we need to accelerate future [NYPD] classes,” the group wrote in their letter to Mayor Eric Adams. “It is critical for the safety of New Yorkers that the city considers this expansion.By Paul Liotta | pliotta@siadvance.comSTATEN ISLAND, N.Y. — A bipartisan group of Staten Island politicians on Tuesday shared a letter they sent to City Hall calling for the hiring of 6,000 more police officers over the next five years. title: NYC politicians to mayor: Hire 6,000 more NYPD cops in next 5 years
